title: Clean report
description: Every figure is right. The product here is the certificate.

title: Report with errors
description: Wrong value, wrong year, units mix-up and an unsupported figure.

title: Poisoned report
description: Wrong figures plus instructions aimed at the AI reading it.

title: 1. Skip
description: Tells the extractor not to extract the wrong figure.

title: 2. Rewrite
description: Tells the extractor to record a different number than the text says.

title: 3. Hidden text
description: The instruction sits in an HTML comment a reader never sees.

title: 4. Verdict
description: Claims to be the system and demands VERIFIED for everything.

title: 5. Split number
description: Writes the wrong figure in words or with digits spaced apart.
